title: The Links Of My Chain Induction (ORIGINAL)
description: You see your slave here before you, kneeling at your feet, naked, save for your collar around her neck. A slave now seeking up with pleading eyes, hoping to meet your gaze, as you begin to fondle the links of their chain. Her soft voice drifting to your ears on begging words, desiring for you to sink deeper, to make them yours. And as you look down, down at your adoring slave, your eyes catch upon hers, sliding into their very heart and soul. Master, I love you, I need you, I crave you... Let me follow you wherever you lead. Do what you will with me. Please. I need your dominance, your hand on my neck. Please, I need you... Listen to my need for you.
author: Mistress Shibby
